tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmar po skor gsum gyi gtor bsngo nyung ngu dngos grub myur 'gugs kyi pho nya bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rig byed lha mo sogs dmar po skor gsum la gtor ma 'bul na rang rang gi sgrub thabs kyi rjes sam/ yang na gzhan gyi gtor 'bul dang lhan cig tu phul kyang chog pas/ dang po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i dmar po skor gsum gyi sgrub thabs ltar yin la/ de'i 'khor gnyis kyi zlum gtor rnams lag len bzhin mchod pa bcas bshams la/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ spos kyis bdug bdag bskyed gtor bsngo sogs dmar po skor gsum gyi gtor ma sger mnyam med par yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor ma la 'thus par byed na rigs byed ma yi dam spyi gtor dang gzhan gnyis chos skyong spyi gtor la 'thus/ 'dir phyi ma ltar bshad na rig byed ma'i dbang gtor zla gam/ tshogs bdag nor gzugs/ 'dod rgyal gyi 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs ma dang / rang rang gi phyag len bzhin dang / khyad par gdan sa 'dir dus skabs phal cher kyai rdor lam dus sam/ phur chung bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor bsngo sa lo yab sras kyi phyag len ma 'di la mdzad pas/ de'i dbang du byas na bdag bskyed nas bde mchog gtor bsngo'i bar byas la/ gtor mgron gang yod kyi gtor ma thams cad la byin rlabs rgyas pa yi dam gtor bsngo'i gong du dus gcig tu mdzad nas/ so so'i gtor bsngo'i skabs de gsal 'debs re mdzad pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len yin pas rgyu mtshan des na rig byed ma'i gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyis nam mkhar dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod/

sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing / g.yas 'og mas khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho bcu drug lon pa lta bu dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la g.yas pa'i brang ba gtad pa skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'i 'od kor gyis yongs su mdzes shing snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rig byed kyi phug nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ ku ru kul+le/ gcig sngon 'gro'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra/ gcig sngon 'gro'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs la/ oṃ ku ru kul+la hrīḥswāhā/ oṃ a ka ro btags pas phul/ oṃ ku ru kul+le gcig sngon 'gro'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ku ru kul+le oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dril gsil yod med gang rung dang / dkar mo ri dwags nas/ 'khyud pa nyid bar gyis yid mchod/ brtse ba'i rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs ci shes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar spyi 'gre bzhin/ de nas gur zhal nas bzung / phur srung gtor ma'i bar byas la/ tshogs bdag gi gtor ma byin brlabs gong bzhin/ mdun du baiḍūr+ya'i brag ri'i khrod du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nor bdag byi ba sngon po rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i steng du gaḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing / spyan gsum dang ldan pa dbu skra ral ba'i thor lcog nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin nor bus mtshan zhing / dar dmar po'i cod paṇa 'phur ba/ phyag bcu gnyis kyis g.yas pa drug na dgra satwa/ mda' chen/ lcags kyu/ rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'phang mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na gtun shing / gzhu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa/

phub dang lhan cig mdung la ba dan btags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin cing / lhag ma rnams 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis sham thabs gsol zhing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i dbus su gaḥyig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje g.yab dril gsil zhing / oṃ gaḥgaḥsid+dhi sid+dhi sarba ar+tha me pra sa dhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du brjod pa bkug dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas mdun du bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par gyur pas mos te/ de la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul nas/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya dang / sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ gaḥṇa pa ti na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yeḥsogs btags pa lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ oṃ gaḥṇa pa ti ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gis bar gyis phyi mchod/ oṃ gaḥṇa pa ti oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag

/bgegs kyi gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma/ sogs spyi 'gre/ 'dod rgyal gyi gtor ma byin rlabs gong bzhin/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ dmar po las byung ba'i rin po che pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zla gam sgo gcig pa/ rin po che'i pha gu dang / drwa ba dang / drwa ba phyed pa dang / mda' yab dang pu shu la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa'i rtse mor yid bzhin gyis nor bu rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo'i mdun du rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang ri dwags la sogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdus nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par tshur 'dus te hūm̐ yig la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba las khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas khams gsum 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ de'i pang du yum bde ba rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing / dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ sogs lnga'i mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bhā wā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dmar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥyis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa dmar po g.yas sa gnon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ de gsum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs gsum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha gsum la so sor thim zhing / de gsum yang 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med du gyur/

slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer gyis gtor ma btegs te 'dod rgyal gyi phyag tu phul bas gsol bar gyur/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye'i mthar se gol gtogs la/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu hūm̐/ zhes pa gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ la sogs lngas mchod/ ḍā dril gsil zhing / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dbang bskur pho nya'i las mdzad pa/ /khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni/ /khams gsum 'gugs pa khyod la 'dud/ /ces sogs gang shes kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nas mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gtso mo rnams sku mdog dmar mo ḍā ma ru dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum/ rus pa'i rgyan dang dar dmar po'i na bza' can/ nyi ma'i gdan la gar stabs kyis bzhugs shing / 'khor rnams sku mdog sna tshogs pa gri thod dang ḍā ma ru dang mi rkang gi gling bu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ de rnams la rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa mang pos bdud rtsi bcus te ḍā ki ma rnams kyi thod par blugs pas gsol bar gyur/ rdor thal kha phye se gol gtogs/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum la sogs pas phul/ ḍā dril bsil/ zhing skyes yul gyi dur khrod nas/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo rnams bzhugs pa/ /sku yi gar stabs glog ltar 'khyug gsung gis gsang sngags phyogs bcur sgrog /thugs ni thugs rje'i ngang la gnas/ /sgrub po'i phrin las ci yang mdzad/ /mthu dang nus pa bsam mi khyab/ /stobs chen khyod la gus pas bstod/

/mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs gong ltar brjod pas/ de ltar bgyi'o zhes khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sngon 'gro rnams byas pas don 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dmar po skor gsum gtor bsngo nyung ngu mchod gtor gzhan dang lhan cig tu byas chog 'di yang / sa skya pa kun blos dpal sa skya'i gzhi thog tshoms bar mgon khang du sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i thabs su dmar po skor gsum gyi sku gsar bzhengs byed skabs rgyun gtor 'dzugs pa'i ched du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dmar po skor gsum gyi gtor bsngo nyung ngu / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
